scientific_integrity: The full extraction point-process theorem and its long-time noise limit have a regenerative proof; finite generator checks are supplementary and do not certify untested dimensions or independence.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite chain length precedes high-reset limit; no uniformity as length grows
Poisson convergence is finite-rescaled-horizon; the Fano rate uses long observation times before high-reset rate
Prior mean-current asymptotic is explicitly excluded from the assessed original claim
An unindexed equivalent current-counting theorem remains possible
title: Poissonian extraction noise from strongly recycling exclusion chains
